Not entirely confirmed. No fire detections intersected the asset (ASSET-F47) between 5 October and 4 November 2026, but the check doesn't cover the whole period.

All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) have data through 3 November. The final day, 3–4 November, is not covered by any of them. The latest near-real-time file had not yet been updated for that day, either because it was still in progress or because it hadn't been published.

Under the rule that every day must be covered by each sensor, the period does not count as fully covered. So the accurate statement is: no fires were detected from 5 October to 3 November, and the last day is unverified. Re-running the check once the 3–4 November data is published would let you confirm the full period.

Also note that satellite detections can miss small or short-lived fires, so "no detections" is not absolute proof of no fire.
